meta.name: positioning-statement
meta.description: Create a Geoffrey Moore-style positioning statement. Use when clarifying who you serve, what problem you solve, your category, and why you're different from alternatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 明确你的目标客户、问题、品类和差异化优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用经典框架梳理产品或品牌的市场定位。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your target customer, problem, category, and differentiation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to articulate your product or brand positioning using a classic framework.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你填写 Geoffrey Moore 式定位声明，包括目标客户、未满足需求、产品类别、核心收益和差异化。它会根据你提供的信息自动填充模板，并追问缺失部分。
howto.when: 当你需要明确产品市场定位、对齐团队或测试价值主张时，可以要求 Claude 创建定位声明。典型触发词包括“写定位声明”、“定位产品”等。

say.text: 帮我写一个针对中端市场HR团队的B2B SaaS定位声明。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写 Moore 模板的各个部分。

say.text: 为我们的项目管理工具写一个定位，区别于Asana和Jira。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供目标客户、需求等细节。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through filling out a Geoffrey Moore-style positioning statement, including target customer, underserved need, product category, key benefit, and differentiation. It auto-fills the template based on provided info and asks for missing parts.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to clarify product market position, align team, or test value proposition. Typical triggers include 'write a positioning statement' or 'position my product'.

say_en.text: Write a positioning statement for a B2B SaaS targeting mid-market HR teams.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the Moore template slots.

say_en.text: Position our project management tool against Asana and Jira.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for target customer, need, etc.
